description: Source code for the USBMassStorage plugin in the WPEFramework, managing USB storage device events, initialization, deinitialization, and RPC error handling.

classes.name: USBMassStorage
classes.description: Main class implementing the USB mass storage plugin, handling device events, initialization, and cleanup.

classes.name: USBMassStorage::Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling device mounted/unmounted notifications and connection deactivation events.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up device interface, and registers for notifications.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and terminates connections.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::OnDeviceMounted
methods.description: Handles device mounted events and notifies observers.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::OnDeviceUnmounted
methods.description: Handles device unmounted events and notifies observers.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::OnJSONRPCError
methods.description: Handles JSON RPC errors, translating error codes.
